newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via over-the-weekend system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via over-the-weekend system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Friday via overnight system repurchases, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
Analysts had said the Fed might refrain from open market operations, due to the soft Federal funds rate, but they said the Fed could add reserves via system repurchase agreements.
Fed funds were trading at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate, at the time of the operation.
(( -- E. Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
